meta.subject: Fix LSU address checking issue for local memory access. Related to #70.

en.summary: The patch fixes local-memory address classification by checking against the configured LDS base range instead of comparing raw addresses to a small size limit.
why_it_counts: LSU.scala changes is_shared from a low-address limit check to an LDS_BASE range check.
CSR.scala also builds lds_base_dispatch from LDS_BASE instead of a hard-coded constant slice.
The commit subject explicitly names an LSU address checking issue for local memory access.
disqualifiers: The commit also changes the default testcase entry in ventus/txt/_cases.ini.
evidence: parameters.scala adds LDS_BASE as a named top-level parameter.
LSU.scala renames the constructor argument to sharedmemory_maxsize and uses the full base-range check.
CSR.scala replaces the hard-coded 0x70000000 prefix with LDS_BASE when dispatching the LDS base.

fault_injection_plan.target_module_or_logic: LSU shared-memory address-range classification and LDS base dispatch
fault_injection_plan.suggested_edit: In AddrCalculate, restore the old low-address check, and optionally restore the hard-coded 0x70000000-based lds_base_dispatch construction in CSR.scala.
fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Valid local-memory accesses above low offsets are misrouted as global accesses, breaking LDS semantics.
notes: Reverting only the LSU predicate is enough to recreate the core behavior bug.
fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A local-memory region is mapped at a configurable base address, not necessarily near zero. If the LSU classifies local-memory accesses by comparing the full address only against the region size, valid addresses above that low range are mistaken for global memory.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A local-memory access uses an address in the configured local-memory region but not in the low 0..size-1 range.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Decode local memory using only a size threshold or a stale hard-coded base.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: replace base-range compare with low-address or stale-base check
portability_notes: The reusable bug is ignoring the configured base when classifying the address.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the predicate that decides whether a load/store targets local/shared memory.
Replace the configured base-window compare with addr < local_size or a stale base.
Issue a local-memory access at local_base + offset and observe misrouting.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: AddrCalculate shared/local classification and CSR LDS base dispatch
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes is_shared to check LDS_BASE <= addr < LDS_BASE + sharedmemory_maxsize and uses LDS_BASE in lds_base_dispatch.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In LSU AddrCalculate, revert is_shared back to addr < sharedmemory_maxsize; optionally also restore the old hard-coded base in CSR.

evidence_for_injection: The changed LSU line is the local-versus-nonlocal classifier.
CSR lds_base_dispatch was updated in the same commit to match the configured base.

zh.summary: 该补丁修复了本地内存地址分类错误，改为依据配置的 LDS 基址范围判断，而不是把原始地址与一个很小的大小上限直接比较。
why_it_counts: LSU.scala 将 is_shared 从低地址上限判断改成基于 LDS_BASE 的范围判断。
CSR.scala 也改为使用 LDS_BASE 构造 lds_base_dispatch，而不是写死常量片段。
提交标题明确指出是本地内存访问的 LSU 地址检查问题。
disqualifiers: 该提交还顺带修改了 ventus/txt/_cases.ini 中的默认测试项。
evidence: parameters.scala 新增了具名顶层参数 LDS_BASE。
LSU.scala 将构造参数改名为 sharedmemory_maxsize，并使用完整的基址范围检查。
CSR.scala 在分发 LDS base 时用 LDS_BASE 替换了写死的 0x70000000 前缀。

fault_injection_plan.target_module_or_logic: LSU 的共享内存地址范围判定与 LDS base 分发逻辑
fault_injection_plan.suggested_edit: 在 AddrCalculate 中恢复旧的低地址判断；如需完整回退，也可在 CSR.scala 中恢复基于硬编码 0x70000000 的 lds_base_dispatch 构造。
fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 位于较高 offset 的合法 local-memory 访问会被误路由为 global access，破坏 LDS 语义。
notes: 只回退 LSU 谓词就足以重现核心行为错误。
fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: local-memory 区域映射在可配置基址上，并不一定靠近零地址。如果 LSU 在分类 local-memory 访问时只把完整地址与区域大小比较，那么所有高于这段低地址范围的合法 local 地址都会被误判成 global memory。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某次 local-memory 访问的地址落在配置区域内，但不在低地址 0..size-1 范围内。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 仅用大小阈值或过期的硬编码基址来判定 local memory。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 用低地址或陈旧基址检查替换基址范围比较
portability_notes: 可复用的错误本质是：分类地址时忽略了配置基址。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到决定 load/store 是否命中 local/shared-memory 的谓词。
把基址窗口比较改成 addr < local_size 或陈旧基址。
访问 local_base + offset 并观察其被误路由。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: AddrCalculate 中的 shared/local 分类与 CSR 中 LDS base 分发
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复把 is_shared 改成检查 LDS_BASE <= addr < LDS_BASE + sharedmemory_maxsize，并在 lds_base_dispatch 中使用 LDS_BASE。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 LSU AddrCalculate 中，把 is_shared 改回 addr < sharedmemory_maxsize；如需完整回退，也可恢复 CSR 中旧的硬编码基址。

evidence_for_injection: 被修改的 LSU 语句正是 local 与 nonlocal 的分类器。
同一提交还更新了 CSR 中的 lds_base_dispatch 以匹配配置基址。
